newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Omnitel says subscribers up in Q1 1997.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Omnitel says subscribers up in Q1 1997.

text.p: Italy's second GSM mobile phone service manager Omnitel said it had 913,000 subscribers at the end of the first quarter in 1997, up 200,000 from the number at the start of the year.

In a statement, Omnitel, which is controlled by an Olivetti -led international consortium, called the result "excellent if you consider that the first quarter of the year is traditionally one of the lowest points of the market."
It said the first three months had widely surpassed the company's budget expectations and it confirmed its 1997 investments for 600 billion lire.
